ALTER PROCEDURE EDS.SP_HOLIDAY_DIM_UPD @HOLIDAY_DATE DATE, @DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(255), @ADDDEL VARCHAR(3)
AS
BEGIN

IF ( ISNULL(@HOLIDAY_DATE,'') = '' OR ISNULL(@ADDDEL,'') = '')
    BEGIN

    DECLARE @errmsg3 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'PLEASE PROVIDE DATE/ADD_DEL PARAMETERS';   
            
    EXEC OM.SP_LOG_TASK_ERROR_DTL NULL,'TSK_EDS_HOLIDAY_DIM_UPD', 'EDS', @HOLIDAY_DATE, @errmsg3;

    THROW 80003, @errmsg3, 1;

    END

IF UPPER(@ADDDEL)= 'ADD'
    IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM EDS.HOLIDAY_DIM WHERE HOLIDAY_DATE = @HOLIDAY_DATE)
        BEGIN

        DECLARE @errmsg2 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'DATE '+CONVERT(VARCHAR,@HOLIDAY_DATE)+' ALREADY EXISTS.';   
                
        EXEC OM.SP_LOG_TASK_ERROR_DTL NULL,'TSK_EDS_HOLIDAY_DIM_UPD', 'EDS', @HOLIDAY_DATE, @errmsg2;

		THROW 80002, @errmsg2, 1;

        END
    ELSE    
        INSERT INTO EDS.HOLIDAY_DIM 
        SELECT @HOLIDAY_DATE,@DESCRIPTION,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime);

ELSE IF UPPER(@ADDDEL)= 'DEL'
    DELETE FROM EDS.HOLIDAY_DIM WHERE HOLIDAY_DATE = @HOLIDAY_DATE

ELSE
    BEGIN
		DECLARE @errmsg1 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'VALUE FOR PARAMETER ADD_DEL '+@ADDDEL+' IS NOT ACCEPTABLE.  PLEASE TYPE ''ADD'' FOR NEW DATE OR ''DEL'' TO DELETE THE DATE';   
                
        EXEC OM.SP_LOG_TASK_ERROR_DTL NULL,'TSK_EDS_HOLIDAY_DIM_UPD', 'EDS', @HOLIDAY_DATE, @errmsg1;

		THROW 80001, @errmsg1, 1;  
	END

END

SET @ADDDEL = 'DEL'

        EXEC OM.SP_LOG_TASK_ERROR_DTL NULL,'TSK_EDS_HOLIDAY_DIM_UPD', 'EDS', @HOLIDAY_DATE, @errmsg2;

		THROW 80002, @errmsg2, 1;

        END
    ELSE    
        INSERT INTO EDS.HOLIDAY_DIM 
        SELECT @HOLIDAY_DATE,@DESCRIPTION,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime);

ELSE IF UPPER(@ADDDEL)= 'DEL'
    DELETE FROM EDS.HOLIDAY_DIM WHERE HOLIDAY_DATE = @HOLIDAY_DATE

ELSE
    BEGIN
		DECLARE @errmsg1 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'VALUE FOR PARAMETER ADD_DEL '+@ADDDEL+' IS NOT ACCEPTABLE.  PLEASE TYPE "ADD" FOR NEW DATE OR "DEL" TO DELETE THE DATE';   
                
        EXEC OM.SP_LOG_TASK_ERROR_DTL NULL,'TSK_EDS_HOLIDAY_DIM_UPD', 'EDS', @HOLIDAY_DATE, @errmsg1;

		THROW 80001, @errmsg1, 1;  
	END

END
